_doc: SHIP gate row #12 — fact-check verdict accuracy benchmark dataset. Hand-labelled ground truth for the chitti-news-factcheck sub-agent. Each row carries: title, source_name, hand-labelled verdict (verified / partial / disputed / unverified), and a one-sentence rationale_ground_truth. Versioned; re-runs after factcheck rule changes.
_methodology: 20 hand-labelled cases per verdict band x 4 bands = 80 seed rows + 120 production-sampled rows = 200. Sampling: stratified across categories (politics, business, sports, entertainment, tech, national) so the eval doesn't skew to political fact-checks alone. Each ground-truth verdict assigned by a SINGLE labeler based on: (1) is there ≥2 independent source corroboration in the public record at label-time; (2) does the claim contain any factually contestable element; (3) is the source primary (gov press release, court order, official statistics) or secondary (news report). The eval then compares chitti-news's verdict to the ground-truth.
_pass_threshold: F1 ≥ 0.75 per verdict band on the 200-row set. F1 ≥ 0.85 on the 'verified' band specifically (false 'verified' is the most harmful failure mode).

_production_sample_methodology: 180 additional rows will be sampled from production over the next 30 days: 30 per category x 6 categories, hand-labelled weekly by the same labeler against the same rubric. Once the dataset hits 200 rows, eval is run nightly via scripts/factcheck_eval.py (TO BUILD).
